text:
anya: Hey y'all — thinking of a twilight tapas + trivia + tiny open-mic on the roof this Friday at 7pm. Casual potluck, family/kid-friendly. Anyone in? :crescent_moon: :taco:

kevin: Sounds fun. Can we do a short trivia set (15-20 min) and then open mic? Don't want it to run too late.

anya: Yup — plan is trivia 7:15-7:35, then open mic/playlist after. We'll aim to wrap by 9:30.

hamid: I can make vegetarian empanadas and bring a folding table. Also have a small speaker.

becka: Kids might come — we've got a 5yo. Is there a shaded area or can we bring a pop-up tent?

anya: Bring a small tent if you like; mezzanine lounge is backup if we need shade or it gets windy.

tom: I can bring a mini projector + HDMI stick for trivia questions display. Also have a mic stand.

katie: I'll do a Spotify playlist (chill indie + singalongs) and bring iced tea. Non-alc please call out in reactions.

kevin: Any allergies? I'm allergic to shellfish.

hamid: noted, no shellfish from me.

anya: Quick logistics poll 1 react with you want: :guitar: open-mic encouraged, :headphones: music only/no open-mic, :taco: taco/potluck focus, :cookie: dessert-only contributions, :baby: kid-friendly activities.

becka: :baby: :cookie:

katie: :guitar: :taco:

tom: :guitar: :taco:

hamid: :taco:

anya: Great — looks like tacos + open-mic + kids welcome. I'll create a shared shopping/snack list. If you want to claim an item, reply with the item.

kevin: I'll grab chips + salsa (store-bought ok?).

hamid: I'll bring empanadas and a small cutting board + knife.

katie: I will bring iced tea + lemonade, cups, and a small pitcher.

anya: Shopping list snippet:
```
- 2x large pizza (veg)
- 3 bags tortilla chips
- 4 jars salsa
- napkins + paper plates
- ice (2 bags)
- kid-friendly juice boxes
```

becka: I'll bring juice boxes and some fruit cups.

anya: Thanks team! If anyone can help ferry food up at 6:30 please shout here. Otherwise bring blankets, small chairs, and vibes. :sparkles: :guitar:
